title: SERUM 2 / 61 - original hardware concept, audited revision

subject.summary: Unaffiliated concept, not endorsed by Xfer Records. An original standalone hardware proposal for the documented Serum 2 architecture, designed in one autonomous agent run; this is its audited revision. Native firmware is the user's premise; every physical part is designed, many to a documented requirement. The model does not synthesize audio.

facts.value: Original native Serum 2 standalone hardware design; every physical size and shape is designed, not Xfer hardware evidence.
35 W sustained compute allowance; performance unbenchmarked

facts.note: Three independent primary oscillators A/B/C; each selects wavetable, multisample, sample, granular or spectral. Independent enable, initialization, copy/swap with or without modulation, lock, pitch and bend tracking.
Octave, semitone, fine and continuous coarse pitch remain separate destinations; semitone, harmonic, ratio and tuning-step modes with appropriate source selection.
2D/3D visualization, frame position, smooth interpolation, phase, random phase, phase legato/memory; up to 16 unison voices with mode, stack, detune, blend, width, range and per-voice offsets.

Two warp stages; sync/variable softness, alternate bends/remaps, quantize, odd/even, filters, distortions, FM including thru-zero/linear/exponential behavior, PD, AM, RM and documented modulator choices including oscillators and filters.

Factory and imported SFZ instruments, timbre shift, velocity response, per-sample envelope override with delay/A/H/D/S/R, random start, unison, warps, pan/level and convert last played sample to Sample mode.

File import and root note, start/end, snap/zoom, auto/manual slicing, threshold, slice-to-end/single-slice/root selection, score extraction/playback, scan/rate, reverse, pitch, dual warps and conversion to wavetable.
One shot, forward, reverse, forward/reverse and tailed behavior; loop points, relative/link loop length, release exit and crossfade. Preserve modulated loop reversal when endpoints cross.

Sample and loop operations, manual position, density modes/free/BPM/grain count, maximum grains and jump start, grain length modes, window amount/skew/shape, unison spawn patterns, per-grain randomness, reverse grains and X/Y destination selection.

Sample time scanning independent of pitch, manual position, FFT phase lock/transients, frequency bounds with smoothing/post-warp, spectral cutoff/mix and custom curve or wavetable mask, X/Y choice, unison/warps and sample-to-wavetable conversion.
Dedicated waveform, pitch, phase, pan, level and routing.
Factory/user sample, one-shot/looping, start/random, pitch/fine, pan, level and routing.

facts.value: Two synthesis filters; official manual pp. 133-143
facts.note: Independent enable/model, cutoff, resonance, drive/clean mode, model-dependent variable, stereo cutoff pan, mix and output gain; pitch tracking and frequency/phase/FFT visualization.

facts.value: Filter model depth; official manual pp. 135-141
facts.note: All documented filter model families including virtual analog models and drawable PZ SVF; preserve model-specific variable behavior and editable response.
Each oscillator can feed filters with balance, Main, Direct or None; independent Bus 1/2 sends, pan/level and applicable ENV1 gating switch. None preserves a modulation-only oscillator.

facts.value: Filter and bus routing; official manual pp. 148-151
facts.note: Filters feed the other filter/Main/Direct/None plus sends; buses feed Main/Direct/other bus. Independent levels, filter mixes, rack bypass and Main/Direct levels. Preserve legal engine routing semantics.
Main, Bus 1 and Bus 2 racks; add/remove/reorder/duplicate, copy with/without modulation, rack/module presets, lock, individual/all bypass, and modulate eligible parameters.
Bode, Chorus, Compressor, Convolve, Delay, Distortion, Equalizer, Filter, Flanger, Hyper/Dimension, Phaser, Reverb and Utility; retain every module parameter and algorithm option.

facts.value: Complex FX editing; official manual pp. 163-169,175-181
facts.note: Multiband compression, imported convolution IR and processing; both X-Shaper curves; all documented reverb styles; nested Low/High, Low/Mid/High and Mid/Side splitter child racks.
Four independent envelopes, ENV1 amplitude role, A/H/D/S/R, attack/decay/release curves, MS/BPM, legato inversion, zoom and assignment operations.
Ten LFOs, Normal/Path/Lorenz/Rossler/S&H; mono/poly, free/retrigger/envelope with start/loopback, direction, grids, preset shapes, host sync, Hz/BPM/triplet/dotted, rate/rise/delay/smooth/phase.

facts.value: LFO graph editing; official manual pp. 189-200
facts.note: Point/step/ramp tools, add/remove/select/relative move, snapping, all-curves adjustment, point modulation, larger editor and bidirectional LFO/wavetable shape transfer.
Positive/negative depth, unipolar/bipolar behavior, assignment display, bypass/remove/reassign through parameter and source contexts.
Editable velocity and note response graphs, multiple points/curves, initialization and legato/portamento behavior; assign as modulation sources.
Eight named multi-destination controls, source and destination roles, depth, assignment inspection and swapping.

64 slots and 49 documented sources; source/destination, source remap curve with rise/fall slew, signed amount, polarity, auxiliary source/invert/curve, output scale/live graph, bypass/delete/reorder/sort/lock and convenience creation/macro baking.

facts.value: Extended modulation sources; official manual pp. 208,210-211
facts.note: Oscillator/filter outputs, active voices, note alternation/random/discrete random, release velocity, voice index/mod1/mod2, MPE/note expression XYZ, wheels, channel/poly pressure, pitch bend and Fixed. Retain all engine source choices.
Mono/poly count, legato, portamento time/curve, always/scaled behavior.
12 clip slots; banks/presets, mono/poly operation, edit-all, launch/trigger behavior, rate, transpose, modes and slice timing, velocity and gate, lock and MIDI trigger octave.

Full piano roll with polyphonic note pitch/time/duration/velocity, selection and clipboard/time-range operations; grid, zoom/fold, start/end/offset, quantize, chop, legato, reverse, mute, conform to scale and time scaling.
Record keyboard/MIDI performances using overdub or extend; generated MIDI output Off/Clip Player/On; clip into arp then key/scale processing; macro assignment remains available.
Arp slots/banks/presets, launch quantization/edit-all/lock and trigger octave; factory shapes plus fully editable custom patterns.

facts.value: Arp pattern depth; official manual pp. 250-262
facts.note: Pattern length/modes/random time, step modes, wrap/transpose range, note event editor and automation lanes including accent/strum; shape/rate/shift/range, playback offset/repeats/gate/chance/divide, latch/thru, retrigger and velocity decay/target.
Transpose, key/scale, swing/division, oscillator and arp key/velocity mapping for splits/layers including repeated octave-specific mapping behavior.

facts.value: Wavetable frame editor; official manual pp. 274-277,281-290
facts.note: All drawing tools, grid, frame selection/reorder/insert/remove/copy/paste/sort, single/all processing, morph operations, import/export/save and dirty-state indication.
Harmonic amplitude and phase bins in the wavetable editor's FFT area: clear, generate, randomize, octave shift, repeat, odd/even drawing and snapped values.

Single/multicycle and multiple-file import, zero-snap/dynamic/frequency estimation/fixed-size/FFT methods, numeric/pitch import overrides, per-file .txt and FolderInfo.txt text file overrides, image luminance import, content embedding and missing-file repair.
Complete documented math functions/operators/constants/variables including x/w/y/z/q/in/sel/rand; single/all-frame or harmonic generation, formula presets and editable user formula files.
Up to eight voice-control steps, oscillator targeting, per-step settings and mod1/mod2, random pan/detune/cutoff/envelopes, envelope/LFO scaling and configuration presets.
Draft 1x, High 2x, Ultra 4x oversampling; smoothing and Serum1 compatibility, quality lock and Ultra offline rendering preference.
Concert pitch, .tun loading, tuning lock and MTS-ESP integration for shared tuning.
MPE enable/default, XYZ mappings and pitch range, expression axis polarity, MIDI CC learn/map load/save and preset mapping behavior.

Folders, search/name/category/tags/ratings, previews including fallback/embedded clip and macro audition, metadata, create/move/rename/delete, database repair, preset pack import/export with metadata/artwork/locks and embedding dependencies.

facts.value: Editing and preferences; official manual pp. 23-27,312-315,323-326,340-345,349-353
facts.note: Undo/redo, fine/reset/exact entry, contextual help, module locks/init/copy, render/resample/export, preferences and power-user text files, MIDI/note preset and oscillator-preset stepping, file structure, update/version and shortcuts-equivalent operations.
DAW track insertion, drag audio/MIDI to host, host transport/sample position/tempo and DAW-shared tuning need explicit appliance equivalents or declared interoperability limits.

Audited revision of the original autonomous run (one 64-minute session, GPT-6.1 Sol in Codex). Changed: requirement links, an unsupported detail removed from R35, FILES and SHIFT/HELP keys, black-key height, solids closed and seated. Not a redesign. Second revision: case closing slip/returns, deliberate reveals and interface-sourced export finishes; original requirement links retained. Self-reviewed in solid and Cycles.
